competitors.what_they_have: The reference result for French PVT queries (dated, modified 17-12-2025, 53 comments). Three chapters: when to claim, DASP online, DASP by post. Eligibility as a 4-item list, 5-step visa cancellation procedure (form 1194, parts A, C and D) for people who left before the visa ended, online vs postal routes, 12 % and 65 % figures, 'gratuit'. Weak: no FAQ block, no figures with sources, no timing number, no ATO-held super, no payment-method detail. This is the one to beat.

'Guide 2026' in the title, dated 17-02-2026. Sections: what super is, conditions, how much you get (worked example 3 000 $ -> 1 050 $), step-by-step on the ATO DASP portal (4 steps with a screenshot), FAQ (balance over 5 000 $, coming back to Australia, forgotten super). 28-day payment, 5 000 $ certification, 6-month transfer to the ATO, EFT vs international cheque. Heavy affiliate banners.

Longest and freshest (modified 27-08-2026, 17 min read). Covers checking the employer pays, Payday Super from 1 July 2026, fund fees, 7-step online procedure, paper form NAT 7204 sent to each fund, form 1194, 5 000 $ threshold, 28 days then contact the fund after a month, online application about 30 minutes, ATO-held super with no deadline, 'can you come back to Australia', 'do not confuse super and tax return', 5-question FAQ. Sells its own NAATI translation service.

Official source (updated 21 April 2026): eligibility, start and save the application before leaving, paper forms NAT 7204 (funds) and NAT 74880 (ATO-held), 5 000 $ certification and Form 1194, 28-day service standard from a complete application, three payment methods with the IMT restriction, WHM rate table. English only for French speakers (no French ATO page found).

gap_summary: All three French competitors give a visible step-by-step procedure, the online vs paper routes with form names, and payment methods. Our page has none of these visibly (the HowTo exists only in JSON-LD, which also breaks Google's rule that markup must match visible content), has no answer-first opening (the hero lead is a slogan), no dated figures block, and two statements that the ATO contradicts (28 days 'after approval'; the portal only handles funds you already know). Our edge, which none of them has: one page that answers every sub-question in a self-contained H2, plus FAQs written to be quoted, and a real next step.

changes.new_text:
1. Vérifiez que vous pouvez déposer. Votre visa doit avoir expiré ou été annulé et vous devez avoir quitté l’Australie. Vous pouvez contrôler votre statut de visa sur VEVO, le service en ligne du Department of Home Affairs.
  2. Retrouvez chaque compte. Dans la demande en ligne de l’ATO (DASP Online), votre TFN suffit pour que le système cherche vos comptes et les affiche. Sans TFN, vous saisissez chaque fund avec son ABN.
  3. Remplissez une demande par compte. Le système crée une demande séparée pour chaque compte trouvé, super détenue par l’ATO comprise. Comptez environ 30 minutes.
  4. Préparez les documents. À partir de 5 000 $ sur un même fund, attendez-vous à des copies certifiées de vos pièces d’identité.
  5. Choisissez le mode de paiement. Compte australien, chèque en dollars australiens ou, pour la super d’un fund qui le propose, virement international.
  6. Attendez le versement. Le fund retient 65 % sur la part imposable, puis paie en général dans les 28 jours suivant une demande complète.

Sans passer par internet, la demande papier se fait avec le formulaire NAT 7204, envoyé à chaque fund, et le formulaire NAT 74880 pour la super déjà détenue par l’ATO.

facts.fact: WHM DASP withholding: 65 % on the taxable component (taxed and untaxed elements), nil on the tax-free component; ordinary temporary-resident rates 35 % taxed, 45 % untaxed.
WHM rate applies if the DASP includes contributions made while holding a 417 or 462 visa (or associated bridging visa), and then to the entire payment; otherwise ordinary rates apply.
Eligibility: super accumulated on a temporary visa (not 405/410), visa ceased, left Australia with no other active visa, not an Australian or NZ citizen or permanent resident.
You can start and save an online DASP application before leaving; you can only submit after leaving and once the visa has ended. The ATO strongly recommends starting before departure.
You cannot submit while a temporary visa is still active, even after departing; check status on VEVO.
Unclaimed super is transferred by the fund to the ATO once at least 6 months have passed since you left and your visa ceased.
Online application is free and covers fund-held and ATO-held super. Paper: NAT 7204 to each fund, NAT 74880 to the ATO for ATO-held super.

5 000 $ or more: fund may require certified copies of ID; paper applications may need a Certification of Immigration Status (Form 1194, Home Affairs, fee). Under 5 000 $: evidence of departure and visa expiry. Online checks immigration status automatically.
Payment generally within 28 days of a completed application; incomplete applications take longer.
Payment methods: EFT to an Australian account, AUD cheque, international money transfer (fund-held super only, not all funds). ATO-held super: Australian account in your name or cheque.
Do not include a DASP in your tax return (final tax).

With a TFN entered, DASP Online searches for your super accounts and displays them; without it you enter account details, using the fund ABN. One application per account. Online check about 45 seconds; application about 30 minutes; service standard 28 days.
Details needed: name, date of birth, email, passport country and number, TFN (optional), fund details including ABN, member number where possible.
Employer super generally does not depend on visa (with work rights) or tax residency.
Super Guarantee 12 % since 1 July 2025, unchanged 2026-27; Payday Super from 1 July 2026.
France is not a Reciprocal Health Care Agreement country; WHMs from non-RHCA countries can apply for a Medicare levy exemption with a Medicare Entitlement Statement.
